title: work-state.json (schema 1) — F1
description: Canonical, self-contained snapshot of a Work. Authority over the Work's persisted state (ADR-0013). Written only by the core, atomically (temp + rename). Plugins never read or write this file.

work.description: Core-governed domain state. Plugins cannot create or write keys here.

id.description: Opaque, sortable, stable identity generated at creation (e.g. ULID).

slug.description: Short human-readable identifier chosen by the user.

status.description: F1 only ever writes 'in-progress'. 'archived' arrives with F2.

start_mode.description: F1 only ever writes 'new'. 'contribution' / 'fork' arrive with F4.

starter.description: Logical name of the Starter that resolved the source. F1: 'local-path-starter'.

branch.description: The created branch name (interpolate(prefix, slug); for 'freeform' == slug).

base_branch.description: Short name of the base ref the branch was started from.

branch_convention.description: Resolved convention name. F1: 'freeform'. Omitted only in contribution mode (unreachable in F1), hence required here.

last_accessed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC. Equals created_at at creation; bumped on resume (F2).

meta.description: Extensible metadata published by components. Empty in F1.

links.description: First-class external relations, one value per semantic key. Empty in F1.
